name: Example Location — The Old Gatehouse
ambient: Cold air, wet stone, and the smell of rust. This is invented example geography for the vertical slice, not a canonical Ravenloft map.

doors.name: Crypt Door
doors.description: (EXAMPLE) A black oak door bound in iron. The lock is old but sturdy; the iron keyhole is choked with rust.

doors.name: Storeroom Door
doors.description: (EXAMPLE) A sagging door, swollen with damp. It is not locked.

npcs.name: Miruna
npcs.look: (EXAMPLE) A villager in a wet shawl stands pressed against the wall, holding a cold lantern. She is breathing hard.

npcs.name: Corvin, the Gate-Warden
npcs.look: (EXAMPLE) A gaunt figure in a rotted gatehouse tabard kneels over the bier. Its eyes catch the torchlight like wet coins.

objects.name: Demo Waystone (Developer Route)
objects.look: (DEVELOPER DEMO ROUTE — NOT CANONICAL GEOGRAPHY) A chalk-marked waystone added for testing. It does not represent a real road from the invented gatehouse to Barovia.

interactions.label: DEMO: Travel to the Village of Barovia staging area
interactions.success_text: (DEVELOPER DEMO) You leave the non-canonical gatehouse demonstration and enter a staging map for the source-grounded area.

objects.name: Gate Bell
objects.look: (EXAMPLE) A great bronze bell hangs from a cracked beam. Its clapper is missing; the rope is still knotted where someone cut it.

interactions.label: Ring the gate bell
interactions.blocked_text: The bell has no clapper. Somewhere in this gatehouse, someone hid it.

effects.text: (MILESTONE - PROJECT ADAPTATION) The gatehouse's debt is answered. The vigil is kept; every adventurer gains the experience of a completed charge.
(EXAMPLE) You fit the clapper and pull. The bell speaks once — a low, carrying note that rolls out over the mist and the dead road beyond the gate. Answering lights kindle in the village below.

objects.name: Shrine of the Morninglord
objects.look: (EXAMPLE) A small stone niche holds a cracked sun-disc. Someone has left dry tinder and a stub of candle here. The air is marginally warmer.

effects.text: (EXAMPLE) You make a cold camp under the sun-disc. Eight hours pass without interruption. Hit points and prepared spells are restored.
(EXAMPLE) The disc is the Morninglord's sun, defaced and then patiently re-carved. The work is recent. Someone here still prays.

objects.name: Supply Crate
objects.look: (EXAMPLE) A waterlogged crate of gatehouse stores, half-submerged. Something metal glints beneath the floating grain.

interactions.label: Search the crate
interactions.success_text: (EXAMPLE) You find a waxed pouch: an iron key, a heavy clapper wrapped in oilcloth, and a potion.
interactions.failure_text: You find only ruined grain and cold water. There may be something deeper in the crate.

objects.name: Stone Bier
objects.look: (EXAMPLE) A stone slab, older than the gatehouse. The name carved into it has been worn away by hands that kept touching it.

interactions.label: Search the bier
interactions.success_text: (EXAMPLE) Beneath the slab: a folded prayer, a purse of old coins, and a stoppered vial that smells of myrrh.
interactions.failure_text: The slab will not move easily, and the carving gives you nothing.

success_effects.text: (EXAMPLE) The prayer names the Gate-Warden as Corvin, and asks the Morninglord to forgive what he became.

effects.text: (EXAMPLE) The floor of the storeroom is a shallow black pool. Something under the water turns toward you.
